entities.name: Kytheon Iora
entities.description: A figure who, with his irregulars, worked outside the law to bring justice to the streets of Akros.

entities.name: Kytheon's Irregulars
entities.description: Kytheon's band, who worked outside the law to bring justice to Akros.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A place whose streets Kytheon and his irregulars sought to bring justice to.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The God-Pharaoh, whose presence is felt in the Second Sun and whose devoted followed his example; he gave Vraska a thaumatic compass.

entities.name: Second Sun
entities.description: A sun in which the presence of the God-Pharaoh is felt.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A world whose most gallant knights wear the sigil of the Patron of the Valiant.

entities.name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
entities.description: A mighty creature whose flight is likened to the sky taking flight.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: The god of knowledge.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who stepped in to help Chandra Nalaar.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who thanks Jace for intervening.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker whose journal notes the tides ignoring the moon.

entities.name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
entities.description: A necromancer who taunts her brother about Ludevic and her own new undead playmates.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: Someone with whom Gisa's brother has chosen to share his creations.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who followed a thaumatic compass from Bolas into a River Heralds' trap.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: A group that set a trap Vraska blundered into.

entities.name: Grete
entities.description: A member of the Order of Saint Traft who entered a church seeking solace.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: An order to which Grete belongs.

entities.name: Munda
entities.description: An ambush leader willing to use foul magic to rid the world of monstrosities.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker necromancer who holds that death is no excuse for disobedience.

entities.name: Curse of Wandering
entities.description: A curse that leaves only hatred in the wandering dead.

entities.name: Karavin
entities.description: A renegade saboteur who makes adjustments others won't appreciate.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: A dragon whose brood is associated with lightning storms.

entities.name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
entities.description: A creature described as the earth walking, strongest of all.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A world with jungles where whiptails browse the canopies.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A speaker who tells Tishana their survival depends on working together.

entities.name: Tishana
entities.description: The one Huatli addresses about working together.

entities.name: Lady of Videns
entities.description: A lady not seen for years, living in an old castle.

entities.name: Yonda of Gavony
entities.description: A speaker who pities the Lady of Videns.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: A region Yonda comes from.

entities.name: Captain Brinely Rage
entities.description: A captain who remarks that nature has risen against them.

events.summary: Kytheon and his irregulars work outside the law to bring justice to Akros.
events.quote: Kytheon and his irregulars worked outside the law to bring justice to the streets of Akros.

events.summary: Jace intervenes on Chandra's behalf, and she thanks him.
events.quote: "Nobody asked you to butt in, Jace. But thanks."

events.summary: Gisa taunts her brother about sharing with Ludevic and reveals new undead playmates.
events.quote: I too have found some new playmates.

events.summary: Following Bolas's thaumatic compass, Vraska blunders into a River Heralds' trap.
events.quote: Carefully following the thaumatic compass Bolas had given her, Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.

events.summary: Grete and companions enter a church seeking solace but find none.
events.quote: "We entered the church in search of solace, but it became clear we wouldn't find it there."
